sections.html: Channa ornatipinnis is a comparatively small (about 20-25 cm) and very colourful snakehead species, described in 2007 from Rakhine State in Burma.

When the species was described in 2007, snakehead fans were enthusiastic, and soon afterwards the first specimens appeared on the ornamental fish market. Since then the fish have been offered regularly, but only from time to time.

However, the imported specimens differed in one detail from the fish in the original description: the colour of the lips. These are blue in the imported specimens, but yellow in the specimens from the original description.

More than 10 years later, fish with the original yellow lips have been obtained from a new source. The collectors do not disclose exactly where the fish come from.
